podcast.body: During recording of *The Colour and the Shape*, Dave Grohl wanted to create a creepy, mysterious effect in the whispering passage around the three-minute mark. He had producer Gil Norton record him in three separate passes: the first reading from a love letter, the second from a technical manual, and the third telling a story about one of the studio technicians working that day. The three layers were mixed over each other in such a way that nothing is decipherable — by design. Whatever Dave said is entirely meaningless. "It sounds cool, but it has no meaning whatsoever."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The song "Everlong" by the Foo Fighters prominently features Dave Grohl's favorite guitar, a Gibson ES-335, specifically his 1967 model. This track highlights the guitar's versatile sound that defines much of the band's work. "Dave Grohl and the Fufutters in Everlong, featuring Dave's favorite guitar, the Gibson Slash Epiphone ES-335."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
